description: This file defines the 'Review' class within the Opencart admin event controller, handling review-related events such as add, edit, and delete review, primarily by scheduling corresponding tasks.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller handling review-related events, such as adding, editing, and deleting reviews, by creating corresponding tasks.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Handles the event for adding a review by scheduling a task to process the new review.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Handles the event for editing a review, scheduling tasks for updating and possibly switching the review's associated product.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Handles the event for deleting a review by scheduling a task to delete the review data.
